name: liturgy-of-the-hours
description: A digital liturgy of the hours: short prayer services drawn from the Book of Common Prayer and beyond.

scripts.start: bun run build-client && bun run src/prayer-app.ts
scripts.dev: bun run build-client && bun --watch run src/prayer-app.ts
scripts.build-client: bun build ./client/home.ts ./client/hour.ts ./client/tagging.ts --outdir ./public/js --target browser --minify --entry-naming '[name].js' && bun build ./client/service-worker.ts --outdir ./public --target browser --minify --entry-naming '[name].js'

author: RL
